inputs.custom_prompt:
Describe what is actually depicted in this image. Cover the following on separate lines:

PEOPLE: For each person, list gender (girl/boy/woman/man/etc), approximate age, hair (colour + style), clothing (colours + items), and any distinctive accessories. End with "total person count: N". If there are no people, write "no people".

OBJECTS: List the prominent objects and props visible (e.g. backpack, teapot, bench, sword, book) with their colour/material.

SETTING: One short sentence describing the location (forest, kitchen, beach, dungeon, etc.) and time of day / lighting mood.

NOTABLE: Anything else that stands out (text, watermarks, logos, blood, deformed body parts, weird artifacts). If none, write "none".

Be concise but specific. Do not invent details that aren't visible.
